notes: A new look: softer light from the Mars sky, sharper full-retina graphics, and a glowing, smoky reactor.
Dust, sparks and confetti are soft and natural now, turrets fire bolts of blue light, and dust storms roll across the screen.
Rock ridges are real rockslides, and small stones are rounded and sand-coloured. The reactor's safe ring no longer dips under the floor tiles.
